$comment: RQ2 coding sheet (PROTOCOL.md §4-§6). One entry per verification-failure episode.
Coder: the AI agent under study (Claude Opus 5.5), 2026-10-21. A second, human coder is required before submission.

Every quote is checked verbatim (whitespace-normalised) against the cited file at the cited ref, or against the commit message when 'commit_message' is true: python -m pytest research/paper_h/tests -q

class: P prose/self-attested; N never executed or could never fail; S wrong locus; I environment could not observe; M negative control invalid or blind; R false statement in an agent-drafted record; C clinical/labelling content not traced to source.

channel: AR adversarial review by separate agent sessions; BP behaviour probe; SA systematic sweep (static analysis or route enumeration); CI continuous-integration run; IM noticed while implementing a related action; EX external research; OW the human owner; SC self-check within the authoring session (SC added post hoc, see RESULTS.md).
introduced.commit: the commit that introduced the defective evidence or claim (null when it never reached a commit). detected.commit: the first commit that records the failure.

stage (added post hoc, checked against git ancestry by failures.stage_problems): 'escaped' = the defective evidence landed on main before the failure was recorded; 'contained' = caught before it landed (or it never reached a commit).

episodes.title: Risk-control verification summary recorded 21/22 controls VERIFIED and 'Failed 0'; adversarial re-verification found 4/22 verified and 12 overstated or not implemented

evidence.quote: conducted by four independent auditors briefed to *falsify* each claim

episodes.title: Security test suite never executed: every module imported a module that has never existed, so not one assertion was ever evaluated
